items.title: SFDR Article 8 fund inflows halve as investors adopt nuanced approach
items.summary: Morningstar data shows funds categorised under Article 8 of the EU's Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation added €41.9bn in net flows during the third quarter.

items.title: Retirement confidence eroding among DC savers amid rising food and fuel prices
items.summary: According to a report by the Defined Contribution Investment Forum and Ignition House, defined contribution savers are losing confidence that their retirement pots will last.

items.title: Francois-Xavier Boisseau shares market insights on Double Indemnity podcast
items.summary: Howden UK and Ireland retail board chair Francois-Xavier Boisseau discusses broker investments and market trends in the latest episode of Insurance Age's podcast.

items.title: Police crime data changes risk distorting London high street insurance pricing
items.summary: A new Seenity study suggests shifts in London high street risk scores may reflect police recording methods rather than true crime changes.

items.title: Fund managers scale back AI expectations and technology weightings
items.summary: Bank of America's Global Fund Manager Survey shows investors cutting tech allocations following economic soft-landing forecasts.

items.title: London Pensions Fund Authority reports £1.36bn surplus in annual figures
items.summary: The London Pensions Fund Authority has published its annual report for 2025-26, showing a funding level of 120%.
